About Stacks

Stacks is a Bitcoin layer that brings smart contracts and DeFi to Bitcoin, including the sBTC bridge. STX is used for fees and in Stacks' Proof of Transfer consensus.

Where this STX price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (STX-USD), Binance (STX/USDT) and Kraken (STX/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 1.80B STX (supply last updated October 30, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
